title: Broaden the Vision: Geo-Diverse Visual Commonsense Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy disparity of vision-and-language models on a multiple-choice visual commonsense reasoning benchmark across images sourced from different geographic regions (Western, East Asia, South Asia, and Africa).

Analyzing the performance gap of models on high-order cognitive visual scenarios that involve distinct cultural customs, traditions, and local characteristics (e.g., weddings, funerals, religious activities, and festivals) compared to generic or Western-centric scenarios.
